title: 第2章  无坚不摧，无物不破
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
“你......你竟敢打我？”
林嫚儿捂着脸，发丝凌乱，白皙的脸颊上赫然是一个鲜红的掌印。
她难以置信地看着陆渊，眼神中充满了惊愕、羞恼。
“打的就是你。”
陆渊负手而立，眼神漠然。
“林嫚儿，以前我是喜欢你，可现在，你在我眼中跟一条狗没什么区别。”
“平时我可以陪你玩玩儿，但你若敢蹬鼻子上脸，就别怪我宰了你。”
林嫚儿愕然愣在原地，没想到陆渊竟然对她如此恶劣。
一股强烈的不真实感从心底涌出。
她嘴唇哆嗦，半天说不出话来，只觉得眼前的男人突然变得好陌生。
那个对她言听计从，连句重话都不敢说的陆渊哪儿去了？
她深吸一口气，脸色难看至极。
“好......好得很！你以为不交出名额就能加入镇魔司？”
“陆渊，只要你敢去县衙，我弟弟一定会把你打成残废。”
言语之中满是威胁之意。
陆渊毫不在意，转身出门。
他的想法很简单：去县衙领取直升腰牌。
如果放在之前，他还会慎重考虑这件事。
毕竟他资质平平，加入镇魔司又是刀口舔血的差事，指不定哪天就会死在妖魔爪下。
可现在觉醒了词条抽奖系统，只有斩杀妖魔才能抽奖，这镇魔司他是去定了。

走在路上，他
【当前可抽取一个红色词条，是否抽奖？】
“抽奖！”
心念一动，无数红色光点出现在视线之中，如光瀑一般在身边流转。
一息之后，一个红色词条停在他的面前。
【您已抽中红色词条：开天】
【开天：无坚不摧，无物不破】
词条分品级，以颜色区分，划为六档：白、绿、蓝、紫、金、红。
白词是最低级词条，可通过合成的方式升级。
三个相同的词条，或是六个不同的词条，可以合成一个高级词条。
让陆渊没想到的是，系统真的太顶了，开局就送一个红词。
开天，那是存在于前世的上古传说。
盘古被困于混沌，没有四方上下，也没有往古来今。
于是他以巨斧打破混沌，摧毁囚笼，悍然开天。
绑定词条后，一股无物不破的极致力量充斥在他四肢百骸。
此时的他，举手投足就能施展出破灭万物的重击。
至于这股力量究竟有多强大，得找机会试一试。
安云县衙。
林辰身穿一袭黑色劲装，在衙门口焦急地等待着。
自打镇魔司选拔新血的消息传开，他这心里就像长了草一样。

习武五年，他比谁都清楚这是个什么机会。
只要能加入镇魔司，银子、灵药自是不必多说，若是有幸能学几手真正的斩妖术法，这辈子就彻底翻身了。
如今他是凡境五层，放眼云安县也是有名的好手，可却要与那些庸才一起参加选拔层层闯关。
而陆渊，什么都不用做就有了直升名额。
凭什么？
这公平吗？
可他转念一想，这几年陆渊被林嫚儿拿捏得死死的，花钱如流水，连一声抱怨都没有。
若是能让他把名额让出来呢？
林辰越想越觉得这事可行，便让林嫚儿去找了陆渊。
他相信，只要林嫚儿开口，陆渊肯定会心甘情愿地把名额让出来。
到时候直升腰牌落在他手上，加入镇魔司还不是易如反掌？
就在这时，一个身穿皂衣的俊逸青年从远处走来。
林辰双眼一亮，脸上闪过一抹兴奋，快步拦在了陆渊面前。
“你来得正好，我姐应该跟你说了吧？等会儿你领了直升腰牌就立刻交给我。”
一句话说得轻描淡写，像是在吩咐下人。
陆渊气笑了，你他娘的站着就想把饭要了？
他目光扫过林辰，一脸鄙夷，“凭什么要把腰牌给你？”
林辰表情一僵，脸上的兴奋随之收敛了几分。
“怎么？我姐没跟你说清楚吗？”
“说清楚了。”

“那不就得了。”
“我不同意。”
“你......”
林辰脸色顿时一沉，眉头紧紧皱了起来。
不同意？
这几年陆渊对林嫚儿视若珍宝，不管是什么要求都会答应。
要他出钱就出钱，要他出力就出力。
怎么会不同意？
“陆渊，你吃错药了？连我姐的话都不听？”
“我告诉你，立刻去领直升腰牌，然后送到我面前，否则我姐不会给你好脸色的！”
“让我给你送腰牌？”陆渊脸上浮现出一丝笑容，“我看你连大小王都分不清楚了。”
陆渊也不会惯着他。
右臂猛然发力，抬手就是一拳重击。
蛮横的力量裹挟劲风，狠狠砸在林辰身上。
速度之快，他根本来不及反应。
只听一声闷响，林辰被砸飞出去，重重摔在地上。
胸口正中皮开肉绽，拳印狰狞凹陷，肋骨不知断了多少根。
陆渊收手，眼中一片漠然，“就你也妄想加入镇魔司？别出来丢人现眼了。”
“小辰——”
一声撕心裂肺的惊呼。

林嫚儿姗姗赶来，正好目睹了刚才的一幕。
这一刻，她整个人都不好了。
她引以为傲的弟弟竟然被陆渊打败了？
这怎么可能！
她连忙上前扶起林辰，看到那胸口的伤势时，脸色瞬间一片惨白。
林辰拜老捕头为师，一身横练功夫已是凡境五层，寻常刀剑连他的护体真气都破不开。
可陆渊只是随手一拳，怎能造成如此严重的伤势？
以林辰的体魄，即便是被刀剑所伤，不消片刻就能凭借自身的恢复能力让伤口止血。
可现在，胸口的拳印一片紫黑，翻卷的皮肉还在往外淌血，根本止不住。
即便林嫚儿不习武，也能看出刚才那一拳太重，伤得不止是皮肉筋骨，连气血都被打散了。
林嫚儿转过头，眼中满是怨毒，“你不想让出名额那就不让，为什么要打伤我弟弟？”
陆渊冷笑道：“他这一身功夫，还不是用我的银子堆出来的？”
“五年，一百多两，拜师的束脩，年节的孝敬，补气血的药材，长力气的肉食，练武护具，跌打损伤......”
“我刚才只是收点利息，不过分吧？”
陆渊每说一项，林嫚儿的脸色就难看一分。
别说习武了，连带着林辰从头到脚的行头，没一样不是花陆渊的银子。
“你......”
林嫚儿后退一步，眼底泛起泪光。
“陆渊，你变了，你以前从来不会这样跟我说话。”
“那些银子都是你自愿赠予的，哪来的利息一说？”

“我就这么一个弟弟，还被你打伤了，错的人是你啊，陆渊！”
陆渊眼神戏谑，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
“是，错的人是我，然后呢？”
“今天我就打你弟弟了，你能怎么样？”
林嫚儿身躯一颤，难以置信地看着陆渊，曾经连句重话都不敢对她说的男人，此刻却变得如此陌生。
她能怎么样？
是啊，她什么都做不了。
之前那一巴掌还在隐隐作痛，如果她现在上去，下场肯定比林辰更惨。
“陆渊，没想到你竟然是这种人，你太令我失望了！”
content_en:
"You...how dare you hit me?"
Lin Man'er covered her face, her hair was messy, and there was a bright red palm print on her fair cheek.
She looked at Lu Yuan in disbelief, her eyes full of shock and shame.
"The one I hit is you."
Lu Yuan stood with his hands behind his hands, his eyes indifferent.
"Lin Man'er, I liked you before, but now, you are no different from a dog in my eyes."
"Normally I can play with you, but if you dare to bite your nose and face, don't blame me for killing you."
Lin Man'er was stunned and froze on the spot. She didn't expect Lu Yuan to treat her so badly.
A strong sense of unreality surged from the bottom of my heart.
Her lips trembled and she was speechless for a long time. She just felt that the man in front of her suddenly became so strange.
Where is that Lu Yuan who obeyed her and didn't even dare to say a harsh word?
She took a deep breath, her expression extremely ugly.
"Okay...very good! Do you think you can join the Demon Suppression Division without handing over your quota?"
"Lu Yuan, as long as you dare to go to the county government, my brother will definitely beat you to a disability."
The words were full of threats.
Lu Yuan didn't care and turned around to go out.
His idea was simple: go to the county government office to get a promotion card.
If he had put it before, he would have carefully considered this matter.
After all, his qualifications are mediocre, and joining the Demon Suppressing Division is a job that licks blood. He may die at the claws of the demon one day.
But now that the entry lottery system has been awakened, only by slaying demons can the lottery be drawn. He decided to decide on this demon-suppressing division.
Walking on the road, he
[Currently, a red entry can be drawn. Do you want to draw a draw? 】
"Lottery!"
With a thought in his mind, countless red light spots appeared in his sight, flowing around him like a waterfall of light.
After a breath, a red entry stopped in front of him.
[You have drawn the red entry: Kaitian]
[Open Sky: Nothing is indestructible, nothing is indestructible]
Entries are graded and divided into six levels: white, green, blue, purple, gold, and red.
White words are the lowest level entries and can be upgraded through synthesis.
Three identical entries, or six different entries, can be combined into one advanced entry.
What Lu Yuan didn't expect was that the system was so powerful that it gave him a red word at the beginning.
Kaitian, that is an ancient legend that existed in the past life.
Pangu was trapped in chaos, with no direction, no up and down, no past and present.
So he used his giant ax to break the chaos, destroy the cage, and open up the sky.
After binding the entry, an ultimate power that was indestructible filled his limbs and bones.
At this moment, he could unleash a blow that would destroy all things with just one movement of his hands.
As for how powerful this force is, you have to find a chance to try it.
Anyun County Government.
Lin Chen, wearing a black outfit, was waiting anxiously at the yamen gate.
Ever since the news about the selection of new blood by the Suppressing Demon Division spread, it felt like grass had grown in his heart.
After practicing martial arts for five years, he knows better than anyone what kind of opportunity this is.
As long as you can join the Demon Suppressing Division, you won't need to talk about money and elixirs. If you are lucky enough to learn a few real demon-slaying techniques, your life will be completely transformed.
Now he is at the fifth level of the mortal realm, and he is also a well-known expert in Yun'an County, but he has to participate in the selection process with those mediocre people.
As for Lu Yuan, he was directly promoted without having to do anything.
Why?
Is this fair?
But then he thought about it, Lu Yuan had been manipulated by Lin Maner in the past few years, spending money like water without even a single complaint.
What if he could be allowed to give up his spot?
The more Lin Chen thought about it, the more he thought it was feasible, so he asked Lin Man'er to go find Lu Yuan.
He believed that as long as Lin Man'er opened her mouth, Lu Yuan would willingly give up his spot.
When the promotion card falls into his hands, wouldn't it be easy to join the Demon Suppression Division?
At this moment, a handsome young man wearing soap clothes came from a distance.
Lin Chen's eyes lit up, excitement flashed across his face, and he quickly stopped in front of Lu Yuan."You came just in time. My sister should have told you, right? When you receive the helicopter waistband, hand it over to me immediately."
The words were said in an understatement, as if he was giving orders to his servants.
Lu Yuan laughed angrily, you fucking want to ask for food while standing?
He glanced at Lin Chen with a look of disdain on his face, "Why should I give you my belt?"
Lin Chen's expression froze, and the excitement on his face subsided a bit.
"What? Didn't my sister tell you clearly?"
"Make it clear."
"That's fine then."
"I don't agree."
"You..."
Lin Chen's face suddenly darkened and his brows furrowed tightly.
disagree?
In the past few years, Lu Yuan has regarded Lin Man'er as a treasure and would agree to any request.
If he is asked to contribute money, he will contribute money, and if he is asked to contribute his efforts, he will contribute.
How could you disagree?
"Lu Yuan, did you take the wrong medicine? Didn't you even listen to my sister?"
"I'm telling you, go get the waistband card right away and bring it to me, otherwise my sister won't look good on you!"
"Want me to give you a waist badge?" A smile appeared on Lu Yuan's face, "I think you can't even tell the difference between a big king and a big king."
Lu Yuan would not tolerate him either.
His right arm suddenly exerted force, and he raised his hand to strike hard.
The arrogant force wrapped up the strong wind and hit Lin Chen hard.
The speed was so fast that he had no time to react.
There was a muffled sound, and Lin Chen was thrown away and fell heavily to the ground.
The skin and flesh were torn in the middle of the chest, the fist marks were savagely dented, and an unknown number of ribs were broken.
Lu Yuan stopped his hand, his eyes filled with indifference, "Are you the one who wants to join the Demon Suppression Division? Don't come out and embarrass yourself."
"Xiaochen——"
A heart-rending exclamation.
Lin Maner came over quickly and happened to witness the scene just now.
At this moment, she was not feeling well.
Her proud brother was defeated by Lu Yuan?
How is this possible!
She quickly stepped forward to help Lin Chen up. When she saw the injury on her chest, her face instantly turned pale.
Lin Chen worshiped the old catcher as his teacher, and he was already at the fifth level of the mortal realm by practicing Kung Fu. Ordinary swords could not even break through his body-protecting Qi.
But Lu Yuan just punched casually, how could he cause such serious injuries?
With Lin Chen's physique, even if he was injured by a sword, he could stop the wound from bleeding in a matter of seconds with his own recovery ability.
But now, the fist mark on his chest was purple and black, and the rolled flesh was still bleeding out, and it couldn't be stopped.
Even if Lin Man'er is not a martial artist, he can still tell that the punch just now was too heavy. It not only injured the skin, flesh, muscles and bones, but also dispersed the energy and blood.
Lin Man'er turned her head, her eyes full of resentment, "If you don't want to give up the spot, then don't give up. Why did you hurt my brother?"
Lu Yuan sneered: "Didn't all his skills come from my money?"
"Five years, more than one hundred taels, apprenticeships, filial piety during the New Year, herbs to replenish qi and blood, meat to increase strength, martial arts protective gear, injuries from falls..."
"I just charged some interest, isn't that excessive?"
Every time Lu Yuan said something, Lin Man'er's face became uglier.
Not to mention practicing martial arts, everything about Lin Chen's outfit from head to toe was Lu Yuan's money.
"You..."
Lin Man'er took a step back, tears welling up in her eyes.
"Lu Yuan, you have changed. You never talked to me like this before."
"The money was all donated voluntarily by you, where is the interest?"
"I'm just a younger brother, and you got me injured. You're the one who's wrong, Lu Yuan!"
Lu Yuan's eyes were playful and a sneer curled up at the corner of his mouth.
"Yes, I was the one who was wrong, and what next?"
"I've beaten your brother today, what can you do?"
Lin Man'er's body trembled and she looked at Lu Yuan in disbelief. The man who once did not even dare to say harsh words to her has become so strange now.
What can she do?
Yeah, there's nothing she can do.
The slap from before was still aching. If she nowIf he goes up there, he will definitely end up worse than Lin Chen.
"Lu Yuan, I didn't expect you to be this kind of person. You disappoint me so much!"
